name: Drawer sidebar
description: Grid layout that shows or hides a sidebar on the left or right.

name: Hero
description: Large box or image with a title and description.

name: Footer
description: Logo, copyright notice and links to other pages.

name: Divider
description: Separates content vertically or horizontally.

name: Join (group items)
description: Groups buttons, inputs and similar items in a horizontal or vertical row.

name: Stack
description: Visually stacks elements on top of each other.

name: Indicator
description: Places an element on the corner of another element.

name: Flex
description: Row/column layout with gap, alignment, wrapping and padding.

name: Grid
description: Column/row grid with gap and spanning cells.

name: Container
description: Centered, max-width page container with padding.

name: Box
description: Generic surface: background, border, radius, shadow, padding, size.

name: Navbar
description: Navigation bar at the top of the page.

name: Menu
description: Displays a list of links vertically or horizontally.

name: Megamenu
description: Large horizontal menu whose items open popovers with navigation links.

name: Breadcrumbs
description: Helps users navigate the website.

name: Tabs
description: Shows a list of links in a tabbed format.

name: Steps
description: Shows a list of steps in a process.

name: Pagination
description: Group of buttons for moving between related content.

name: Dock
description: Bottom navigation bar that sticks to the bottom of the screen.

name: Link
description: Adds the missing underline style to links.

name: Button
description: Lets users take actions or make choices.

name: Dropdown
description: Opens a menu or other element when a button is clicked.

name: FAB / Speed Dial
description: Floating button in a bottom corner that reveals extra buttons when activated.

name: Swap
description: Toggles visibility of two elements via a checkbox or class name.

name: Theme Controller
description: Sets the page theme from a checked checkbox or radio input.

name: Fieldset
description: Container for grouping related form elements.

name: Label
description: Name or title for an input field, placed before or after it.

name: Text Input
description: Simple input field.

name: Textarea
description: Multi-line text entry.

name: Select
description: Picks a value from a list of options.

name: Checkbox
description: Selects or deselects a value.

name: Radio
description: Lets the user select one option from a set.

name: Toggle
description: Checkbox styled as a switch.

name: Range slider
description: Selects a value by sliding a handle.

name: Rating
description: Set of radio buttons for rating something.

name: File Input
description: Input field for uploading files.

name: OTP
description: Input for verification codes (usually 4 to 6 digits), e.g. for 2FA.

name: Calendar
description: Styles for different calendar libraries.

name: Filter
description: Group of radio buttons; choosing one hides the others and shows a reset button.

name: Validator
description: Changes form element colors to error or success based on validation rules.

name: Stat
description: Shows numbers and data in a block.

name: Table
description: Shows a list of data in a table format.

name: List
description: Vertical layout that displays information in rows.

name: Progress
description: Progress bar for a task or the passing of time.

name: Radial progress
description: Circular progress indicator for a task or the passing of time.

name: Countdown
description: Transition effect when a number from 0 to 999 changes.

name: Timeline
description: Shows a list of events in chronological order.

name: Status
description: Small icon showing an element's status (online, offline, error, etc.).

name: Badge
description: Shows the status of specific data.

name: Card
description: Groups and displays content in a readable way.

name: Collapse
description: Shows and hides content.

name: Accordion
description: Shows and hides content, with only one item open at a time.

name: Modal
description: Shows a dialog or box when a button is clicked.

name: Carousel
description: Shows images or content in a scrollable area.

name: Alert
description: Informs users about important events.

name: Toast
description: Wrapper that stacks elements in a page corner.

name: Loading
description: Animation indicating that something is loading.

name: Skeleton
description: Shows a loading state for a component.

name: Tooltip
description: Shows a message when hovering over an element.

name: Avatar
description: Thumbnail representation of a person or business.

name: Chat bubble
description: Shows one line of conversation with its author and time data.

name: Mask
description: Crops the element's content to common shapes.

name: Aura
description: Border light effect that can wrap around any component.

name: Hover 3D card
description: Wrapper that adds a 3D tilt effect following the mouse.

name: Hover Gallery
description: Image container where hovering reveals other images (up to 10).

name: Text Rotate
description: Cycles through up to 6 lines of text with an animation.

name: Icon
description: Sized, coloured inline SVG icons (built-in set or authored SVG).

name: Browser mockup
description: Box that looks like a browser window.

name: Code mockup
description: Block of code in a box that looks like a code editor.

name: Phone mockup
description: Mockup of an iPhone.

name: Window mockup
description: Box that looks like an operating system window.

name: Kbd
description: Displays keyboard shortcuts.

name: Diff
description: Side-by-side comparison of two items.

name: Heading
description: Section titles h1–h6 with size, weight, colour and alignment.

name: Text
description: Body copy, captions and inline emphasis with size, weight, colour, clamp.

name: Form
description: Native form wrapper: Enter submits, ui-submit carries FormData. No styling.

name: Doc form
composed_of: Text input / Textarea / Select / Checkbox / Radio / Fieldset / Collapse / Tabs / Grid / Box / Button
description: Edits a document described by Payload fields (used by the mock backend admin).
